_about: Audit of every ✔ firing of 1.1.71 आदिरन्त्येन सहेता in work/vrtti-gen. Input audit/1.1.71-firings.json. Every quote verified by script as a verbatim substring of ~/Projects/ashtadhyayi-data/sutraani/<file>.txt (id = 5-digit sūtra id) or paribhashendushekhar/data.txt (id = paribhāṣā number). "word" = member-line text between the sūtra number and ⟨…⟩, trimmed. "effect_defects" lists licensed credits whose trigger/effect text is wrong or that carry a caveat — not to be dropped.

conditions.text: Definition: a first element uttered together with a final इत् (marker) denotes the elements between them and itself. The Kāśikā's examples include suffix pratyāhāras: अण् अक् अच् हल् सुप् तिङ्.

quotes.quote: आदिरन्त्येनेत्संज्ञकेन सह गृह्यमाणस्तन्मध्यपतितानां वर्णानां ग्राहको भवति, स्वस्य च रूपस्य। अण्। अक्। अच्। हल्। सुप्। तिङ्।
अन्त्येनेता सहित आदिर्मध्यगानां स्वस्य च संज्ञा स्यात् ॥

conditions.text: सुट् (सु … औट्) is a pratyāhāra: the Kāśikā's counter-example for "अन्त्येन" is exactly सुट्.

quotes.quote: अन्त्येनेति किम्? सुडिति तृतीयैकवचनेन टा इत्यनेन ग्रहणं मा भूत्॥

conditions.text: Not a pratyāhāra although it looks like one: the feminine आप् (टाप्/डाप्/चाप्) is a common name got by dropping the distinguishing markers (सामान्यग्रहण), not 1.1.71; the pratyāhāra आप् (टा … सुप्) is a different thing used in 7.2.112. Likewise a dhātu (इण्, आप्ऌ, चर, अञ्च्), a noun (हल "plough", शर, यम् "whom"), a taddhita suffix (यञ्, अण्), or a word-ending (-अक, -इक) is not a pratyāhāra.

quotes.quote: आबिति टा इत्यारभ्य सुपः पकारेण प्रत्याहारः

conditions.text: इक् via 1.1.3: where guṇa/vṛddhi is enjoined with no sthānin named, "इकः" is understood and is a pratyāhāra. Where the sthānin is given otherwise (अचामादेः carried from 7.2.117, or the उपधा अत् of 7.2.116), 1.1.3's इक् is not what is read.

groups.note: इक् read in through 1.1.3 for guṇa/vṛddhi rules, plus अच्/सुप्/आप्/अण्/इण्. Licensed except: 6.4.138 (अञ्च्), 7.4.69 (dhātu इण्), the feminine आप् (7.3.114, 7.3.115, 7.4.15), and 7.3.34/7.3.35 (the vṛddhi is of the उपधा अत्, no इक्). 7.3.16/7.3.26 are licensed but via अच् (अचामादेः), not इक्. 7.3.90: Bālamanoramā says only वृद्धिः and हलि run on from 7.3.89 (not उतः), so 1.1.3 does give इक्.

unsure.why: रोपध: the pratyāhāra र (र्, ल्) exists (1.1.51), but the sources gloss only रोपधात् and give र-examples (पाटलिपुत्रक, ऐकचक्रक); whether ल-upadhā stems are meant (pratyāhāra) or only रेफ is not stated.

groups.note: Sound qualifiers in suffix rules.
